newsitem.title: CHINA: China First Pencil issues cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: China First Pencil issues cash dividend.

text.p: Shareholders of China First Pencil Co Ltd have approved the company's plan to issue a 0.16 yuan cash dividend per share, a company statement said on Tuesday.
The foreign currency B shareholders will get a $0.019295 cash dividend per share based on an exchange rate of one dollar equal to 8.2923 yuan, it said.
The ex-dividend date for both A and B shares will be July 14, it added.
Trading of the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Tuesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the statement said.
The company reaped a net profit of 55.359 million yuan in 1996 based on international accounting standards against 42.123 million yuan booked in 1995, a company annual report has said.
